feed.content: I don't understand why Google Photos gets an update every other day—and it's always between 80 and 90 MB—which is eating up my phone's memory. I want to know why this is happening. ok I got a reply but tell me what type of update is this and if you are improving then send a stable update like other apps in 5-6 days you guys are sending updates like a newspaper each n every day. difficult to understand the motive behind it.

I liked that it made collages of pictures on its own, suggesting cute core memory framed. What I didn't appreciate is that when I try to download the images or videos in it, it doesn't does that at all despite having the button to do so. Hope you can fix this.

I keep updating the app over and over, it's not updating, it took back to phone pre installed up, I did uninstall it, to reinstall it, but none changed, it keeps under phone version, I lose the option to move pictures and videos to external memory card, since I choose updating every time show me a new version of updating!!! it's not updating at all!!! My phone is android 9 and up, according to the phone factory!!!

I hate how everytime it has photos for me to see from my memories they show my pictures diagonally plus a close up and I can't even see the pictures. how do I turn off pictures being shown to me diagonally everytime a memory shows up. im deleting Google photos

Every other day this app sends me a notification like "Say hello to this familiar face" or "look who we found" and every time it's old photos of my dead cat. Every fing time. Can you please leave me alone. I know she's gone, I don't need to be reminded, it's been three years. Oh and years ago it automatically made a complilation video of photos of a random person in my photos and labeled it "in memory of". this app is truely hilarious at times and packed with unnecessary features.

It is surprising rediscoveries to enjoy without not too much of typing, reading and tweeting and typing and reading and tweeting. it is 07/27/2026 added so much AI. I am not sure as much anymore. I have been using Google Docs, but not Google Drive. The Auto Google photo update seemed too frequent. Therefore, I gave it a try. Did this edit as I also was warned ABOUT the MEMORY STORAGE ...

I don't want my photos to take all my Google cloud memory away from my Gmail account. So, I went to my settings of the (google) Photo app and set it to NOT back up my photos. IT DOES IT ANYWAY!! WHAT'S WORSE, WHEN I DELETE PHOTOS OFF MY PHOTOS APP, STUPID GOOGLE DELETES THEM OFF MY SD CARD AS WELL!!!

easy app to save,organize,navigate, and share photos taken from your camera app, or downloaded. I enjoy using the a.i feature to organize photos by people or animal,by recognizing a familiar face by saving data to memory when the same face appears across multiple photos on different dates and at different locations. the lock /secure box feature gives you privacy in a folder for sensitive photos you may not want to share, the ability to directly share photos and albums youve created , along with

This app in auto memory collection created a memory of my family photo wearing inappropriate clothes including children when I complained to them to fix this they ignored my email and feedback now I am deleting this garbage app that does this using ai. Thank you for your reply but this solution is not good enough.
Dates are completely messed up after backup When I backed up my old phone, all the dates reset to today's date. My entire timeline is a mess now.

Face grouping stopped working for new photos The face recognition was working great for years, but for the last few months it has stopped grouping new photos of my kids. The old photos are still grouped but new ones aren't being added to their albums.
Deleted photos keep reappearing I keep deleting old screenshots and memes from my gallery to save space, but every few days they just reappear in my Google Photos timeline. Sync is definitely broken.

I'm not the biggest fan of folders being on a second page, separated from the first page which only shows camera roll photos. And for some reason, I can't delete photos anymore? It just pulls up an infinitely-looping circle of doom and does nothing. Strange stuff. Otherwise, the app has amazing features that I really enjoy. I love that I can order photos through the app. While I haven't used it yet, I certainly plan to! Altogether, I really just use the app became it came pre-installed.

Within the last 48 hours, I've probably uninstalled and reinstalled this apt close to 10 times. When the app finally backs-up photos, it's missing some (photos that are in my albums on my phone aren't showing up in app). Also when I click on a photo in the app, it opens a different picture. I'm thinking to uninstall app entirely. You'd think Google, of all software out there, could get this right!

Your last update is terrible. You removed the blur option which was AMAZING for blurring the background of my photos of flowers. The flowers would just pop with a heavy blur. The portrait blur is not nearly as good, especially when I use blur and depth to get my flowers to look how I want them to. It DOES look good, but when I save it, the blur almost disappears. Your "upgrade" is really a downgrade.

ugh! what have you done to the editing controls!! get rid of the inefficient and inaccurate AI garage and bring back the custom controls that let me rotate and keystone and crop! AI framing isn't even close to correct! and the manual controls are now so limited I can't even select the correct borders or rotate correctly. the old controls were so much better! one click would pretty closely grab the correct outline and then I could tweak. not anymore!!!

Since the update, I can't choose separate photos for my lock screen wallpaper or main wallpaper. There is only an option for "wallpaper" now, which stretches and distorts the photo to fit the size of the screen! Also in order to continue editing a photo, I have to revert back to the original and edit all over again! Please go back to the original options; why do companies feel the need to constantly change everything every couple months, and not to their users' preference?? So frustrating!

this app worked great until recently. now anytime I crop or edit a picture in anyway, it no longer shows up on my camera, recent photos, or any other album in other apps to post. I thought it was a Facebook issue but as it turns out the photos no longer show up on fb, Lightroom, Vinted, eBay, etc. which is pretty inconvenient if you want to post something. none of the recent updates have fixed this issue. before it was a 5/5 now it's a 3/5 please fix this bug!

why would you take away the ability to share multiple photos at once? I had to send 10 separate emails, with one photo attached a piece, because you took the ability to share multiple photos away! Such a stupid change. In response to Google. No you can not. when you click on a single photo now, you get a share button, if you select multiple photos, the share button is no longer there after the update

Even with the latest updates, it would not let you edit or add location to the backup photos. Some of the photos detected the wrong person or pet or face, and again, it would not let you edit with correct categories. There are many little things like that they need to be more detail oriented when they come out with new/update version.

There have been multiple recent updates and there have been many editing options that have been created. They are great options! However once you edit a photo even just a little (like cropping), the photo frequently becomes unavailable for posting in another app. You get a message that the photo is processing and this can take hours. So, essentially you can't edit a photo if you want to use it immediately in some other app, which is of course often the point of editing a photo. 🤦‍♀️🤷‍♀️

Why can I download some stuff and other stuff, no. It'll just say downloading when I click on it but nothing. Sometimes I'll get a notification like 30 minutes later saying unsuccessful but it's completely random. I don't know why, there's no clues. it's annoying as hell. It can be the same batch of videos from the same day of the same thing, same album. Let's say out of 10, only 7 will download. The others are in some weird download purgatory. At least on mobile.

This app DOES NOT duplicate photos, so if you plan on keeping your photos in the original app you were using, you won't. All of my albums are missing photos because they were taken and placed into google photos, once restored all the photos are mixed together. Also when the photo is "stacked" it only restores one photo. I have over 7,000 photos I was transferring and now everything is so disorganized and there's no easy way to fix it without spending hours trying to figure it out. I am so upset!

My photos are disappearing. I've been using Google Photos for years and even bought extra storage, but for the past four months, I've regretted not just getting a flash drive instead. Many of my photos have vanished, including ones that were very important to me and my family. It's particularly upsetting regarding photos from when my children were younger. Given all the issues with these companies, including their hacks and overall practices, this situation is really frustrating.

So annoying!! Yes I know I'm out of storage. The app completely inundates you with annoying popups, reminding you that you're out of storage, making it impossible to actually, you know, clean up space. I'm going to download all of my photos and videos off of your service, delete the app and never use it again because you annoyed me so much

After a certain amount of time, the app stops labeling photos of a certain person and won't even let me manually label it because it refuses to list the photo of having a face in it. I believe it only happens with people of color, because it has not happened to me with any other photos.

I am paying for Google photo storage for 3TB.... yet there is no customer support to help you when the features don't work. I finally got all my photos uploaded and the face recognition stopped working. it does not see that there is even a face....and when it does, it is not automatically tagging a person. I have face groups turned on, I have cleared the cache, and sent feedback multiple times with requests to email me to troubleshoot.... but I get no help.

Google photos is the only option my phone came with. It's been fine until this last update. Before the last update, when you opened the app your photos would be shown by month/year taken so you only needed to scroll down to see older ones. It was easy and organized. With the new update, the organization is gone. All photos/videos are now shown in a haphazard mess. Sad. This app came with the phone and cannot be deleted and replaced.

The app is absolute garbage. Apparently it saves your files to the cloud and when you remove them, the files are also removed from your device. and Google purposefully made it so that no contact could be made with them directly for this issue or really any issue. i keep getting notified about the storage from Goodle being low and that the options are to remove files or to pay for more storage. To basically continue to send or receive emails.

Why have thumbnails of different sizes for photos. I dictate which of my pics are important, NOT Google. Even then, I want an easily browsable system, not a social media wannabe with useless "Remix" and "Memories" features. Just be the damned file system you are supposed to be. Can't even swipe to select multiple anymore. Also, there is not an option to have your photos ONLY on device. No, I don't need to pay for more Google One storage when my phone has 300 free gigs left for photos and videos.

I don't know how this hasn't been addressed yet, but there has to be a way to stop the little motion preview you get while swiping through motion photos!!! Even with autoplay motion toggle off, there is still a second long preview of the motion in the photo for some reason! It's frustratingly annoying! Especially when trying to swipe through and compare multiple similar photos to see which ones are best, its so jarring that you can't even see the differences fast enough because of the motion!

along with the Constant bugs I have with the phone in general, pixel 10 pro XL, now I can't even crop an image without the app shrinking the image to the point I can barely see it, then when I take my finger off the screen, it jumps back to the original size and the edit is completely wonky. I thought Google was supposed to SET the bar for Android phones, not cause people to switch OS entirely. 👍 edit: you can pass the feedback along to the teams. It's literally your job. 🫡

The back up feature is a scam. Whenever the app backups, it backups ALL your photos & videos. Therefore, you will have doubles & triples of items. Next thing you know, you are out of storage & Google will want you to buy cloud storage! More monthly subscriptions! It should be illegal that you are FORCED to have ALL of your photos & videos uploaded to this app. You have no choice. Even if you install a gallery, there is no way to make that your default photo/video app.

Been steadily getting worse for years, dressed up as being smarter. Any setting I choose or directive I issue I mean absolutely unconditionally, but the app invents "but I know better" options. To be clear, devs — on a roaming mobile network of bad quality with 3% battery at silicon-melting temps, if I say to backup a 1TB file now, I mean fully saturate my upload bandwidth immediately and until the phone is dead, even if it's dead forever by my choices.

I have a problem. in the app it only shows about 1/20 of the photos and videos I actually have. buy if I go to photos in a browser it shows all of them.. this has been happening for years. I don't know how to fix it. all emails and feedback are disregarded or are ignored completely. so ive started using terracotta. one terabytes of storage free.

It has great features but after years of allowing us free storage when uploading in storage saver mode, they changed their policy and I'm out of storage. It feels like they intentionally did this after first trying to hook us and this idea turns me away from wanting to give them my money for more storage (which I imagine would run out pretty quickly).

The memories tiles are showing photos at the top of my photos grid that I do not want to be displayed. They are forcing pictures that I plan to keep, but not necessarily show anyone. This is inappropriate. Memories should have its own spot. The new grid layout is horrible. I can no longer select by day, week, month, etc. keep the photos separate from the memories. Quit changing things just to change them. You're making things worse.

Another failed update, still no perspective correction and I note that you can no longer select a different frame from motion photos anymore, used to be able to bring up all frames in a line and slide back and forth to select a different one from the one this daft SW wants to use. However the crop tool has been returned to how it was which is a start. might give this a second star if you ever put perspective correction back in! AI just can't figure it out properly.

Editing photos is terrible since the new update. Cropping is incredibly difficult and was far better before. There's not even "rotate frame" when cropping. The edited photo will be small (frankly difficult to see) in the middle surrounded by black then when you hold to compare to original picture that goes full screen (impossible to compare how the look because the propations are so vastly different. The brush that selects parts of the photo pain in the neck now, it should be given it's own tab

It won't let me merge peoples labels or import my photos from Google drive. So after another few years of Google photos and drive, I'm about to give up on this service. It's good, yes. But expensive! The amount of duplicates I have of stuff and photos isn't easely mended either. Now that I'm trying to mend all of that and need to download all my stuff from both photos and drive, it's extremely difficult! For some reason Google hasn't got a select all photos! Google takeout is rubbish too.

AI replacement got rid of the best editing features. the number one thing as an artist that I used was the perspective crop tool, followed by some of the color adjustments. they were quick at the fingertips and matched quality that you'd get from Photoshop. low and behold after an update these features no longer exist, making this app absolutely useless imo. I don't care about access through any Google platform, the editing tools were what made it. so disappointed in all the AI integration.

Why is this update?! So cramming full of AI junk is a reason to remove half the functions of the app? what was wrong with the old one? I now cannot apparently reshape my images properly, most of the use I have for the editing app is reshaping photos I take of my paintings. That is apparently not possible now. The 'AI' auto frame doesn't seem to understand 'square, border images' or have a clue what a user might want from an effort to edit one. Useless.

Horrible app. Having the app downloaded eats over half of your "free 15 GB" of storage. Updates constantly shuffle around your photos on social media camera rolls. This app is further proof that I will not purchase a Google smartphone from here on out. If there's one thing I can't stand in photography, it's apps like these that constantly mess with your ability to organize and share your work. Pay for extra storage? That's your answer. Get real and kick rocks Google.

It was great but in collections it only sometimes let's me merge faces with collections I already have, most of the time it won't pick up the collections I already have there so have to save lots of groupings of the same person in duplicate names. Edit: I mean that with some faces, when I try to merge, it's not picking up that there's already a grouping with their name on so I have many groupings named the same, although other faces it's fine and their name shows on the 'suggested' list.

UI downgrade with latest update. Cropping tools are clunkier and less intuitive. Curved handles on corners are more difficult to use precisely, and some editing tools have been removed. The "dynamic" filter now auto crops and straightens the picture, which is usually what I want to do anyway but not always, and now this tool has an unexpected additional effect. Lots of AI based tools I have little interest in added.

Used to love Google Photos, especially the Perspective tool that let me fix slanted angles and straighten lines. Now it's gone with the new update, and there's no substitute. Please bring it back. This was essential for editing architecture, scanned documents, and travel photos. Until then, 2 stars.

I hate the latest update. please change it back. it takes so long to edit something now because you have to scroll across to access the different sliders and you can only see 2 at a time, so you have no idea how long you'll be scrolling for. Light and Colour options are on different menus and you have to exit one to access the other. I used to use both simultaneously. Who designed this?! Have you purposely made it difficult to use because you'll be releasing a paid version? it's infuriating.

Extremely aggressive in trying to get me to back up my photos, turned on auto-backup without my knowing, but what's most annoying is when I deleted from google photos to free up space, it also deleted the same items from my phone. I'm mad and disappointed, I want to be able to delete from one while keeping the other. What's the point of a separate storage space if it forces me to have all the same things stored?

With the last update or couple, the facial recognition got SO bad. It used to be pretty good, recognizing faces 80% or so of the time. Now within ten pictures of clear faces, it'll recognize 10% or even less. But then I save a photo of a 360p face and it's perfectly recognizable?? Or even a silhouette of a side profile is recognized, yet not a clear face. Please fix the facial recognition. I have so many pictures I'd love to put into folders but just can't.

I am on the fence about this app. The new method of organizing is much less user friendly and seems to have missing files. But recently (5 days ago) it updated and yet, at least once a day when I access photos there's a message at the bottom of the screen stating a new version is available. When I click that supposed update, it takes me to the play store and shows it's already installed. So that's fun. Anymore I feel like all Google products and services have taken a dive.
